failures_and_fixes.error: no cmake in PATH and no pip 'cmake' module on this host (the earlier probe notes claimed a pip cmake 4.4.5)
failures_and_fixes.fix: used the cmake 3.28.2 bundled with DevEco Studio: <SDK>/build-tools/cmake/bin/cmake (satisfies Qt's 3.25 minimum)

failures_and_fixes.error: CMake Error at CMakeLists.txt:23 (find_package): Could not find a package configuration file provided by "Qt6" (requested version 6.12)
failures_and_fixes.cause: the OHOS toolchain file pins CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PACKAGE/_LIBRARY/_INCLUDE to ONLY and roots every search in the SDK sysroot, which hides CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH
failures_and_fixes.fix: in the project CMakeLists, append every CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH entry to CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH and set the three *_MODE_* variables to BOTH after project()

failures_and_fixes.error: NodeAddonApi_INCLUDE_DIR not set / napi.h would not be found (neither the OHOS SDK nor the prebuilt Qt ships node-addon-api)
failures_and_fixes.fix: find_package(NodeAddonApi REQUIRED) from the prebuilt package's FindNodeAddonApi.cmake with NODE_ADDON_API_ROOT=/Users/huihui/.dsh/profiles/node_modules

failures_and_fixes.error: qohosplatformfontdatabase.cpp:8:10: fatal error: 'fontconfig/fontconfig.h' file not found
failures_and_fixes.cause: the official Qt for HarmonyOS build links fontconfig statically (vcpkg) and exports the Fc* symbols from libQt6Gui.so; no fontconfig headers exist on this host
failures_and_fixes.fix: generated a 4-declaration shim header build/qt/ohos-plugin-proj/fontconfig-shim/fontconfig/fontconfig.h; llvm-nm confirms the plugin's FcInit/FcConfigGetCurrent/FcConfigAppFontAddDir/FcConfigBuildFonts are version-bound to Qt_6 and resolve from libQt6Gui.so, so no libfontconfig NEEDED entry is created (same as the prebuilt)

failures_and_fixes.error: git apply --check printed 'Skipped patch' for all three files and returned 0, i.e. a false positive
failures_and_fixes.cause: /build/ is listed in the repository .gitignore and git apply skips ignored paths inside a work tree
failures_and_fixes.fix: verify with GIT_DIR=/nonexistent (plain filesystem mode) and additionally apply the patch for real into a pristine scratch copy and diff it against the patched tree

failures_and_fixes.error: first link used default symbol visibility (10.5 MB, all internal symbols exported) and a -z,lazy experiment diverged from the reference
failures_and_fixes.fix: CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden + VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON (only qt_plugin_instance / qt_plugin_query_metadata_v2 and the Q_DECL_EXPORT'ed plugin API remain exported); reverted the -z,lazy experiment after confirming the prebuilt itself ships BIND_NOW/RELRO, so the SDK default is kept

runpath.action: no patchelf needed; libQt6*.so live next to the plugin in app/entry/libs/arm64-v8a

exported_symbols.note: the prebuilt applies Qt's generated version script (Qt_6/NonQt), ours does not, so the plugin's own Q_DECL_EXPORT'ed QtOhos/QOhos* API and a few weak RTTI objects are additionally exported; no Qt6::Core/Gui symbol is exported, so interposition risk is limited to same-named plugin symbols

undefined_symbol_diff.why: link uses -Wl,--no-undefined against the prebuilt Qt and the API 24 sysroot stubs, so every referenced symbol exists at link time; napi_add_finalizer comes from the Napi::Reference persistent-reference bookkeeping of the new hand-off code
